from z3 import *

# Declare variables used in the constraints
# header_size: size of the header (C integer)
# comment_size: size of the comment field (C integer)
# SOX_FIXED_HDR: fixed header size constant (treated as a symbolic constant)
# channels: st->codecpar->channels (C integer)
header_size = Int('header_size')
comment_size = Int('comment_size')
SOX_FIXED_HDR = Int('SOX_FIXED_HDR')
channels = Int('channels')

s = Solver()

# Constraint 1:
#   !((header_size + 4) & 7 || header_size < SOX_FIXED_HDR + comment_size || st->codecpar->channels > 65535)
# This is a negated disjunction, so it is equivalent to the conjunction of the negations:
#   (header_size + 4) & 7 == 0
#   header_size >= SOX_FIXED_HDR + comment_size
#   channels <= 65535
# Included because it constrains header_size, comment_size, and channels together.
s.add((header_size + 4) & 7 == 0)
s.add(header_size >= SOX_FIXED_HDR + comment_size)
s.add(channels <= 65535)

# Constraint 2:
#   !(comment_size > 0xFFFFFFFFU - SOX_FIXED_HDR - 4U)
# Negation of a strict greater-than, so it becomes:
#   comment_size <= 0xFFFFFFFF - SOX_FIXED_HDR - 4
# Included because it bounds comment_size (and indirectly header_size via constraint 1).
s.add(comment_size <= 0xFFFFFFFF - SOX_FIXED_HDR - 4)

# Print the resulting Z3 script constraints
print(s)
